caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of an ornate metal door latch mechanism in two views: a side profile on the left and a front view on the right. The front view shows a rectangular metal plate with intricate geometric cutouts and symmetrical decorative patterns along the vertical edges. At the center of the plate is a circular knob, and a horizontal latch bar extends to the right from the middle of the plate, showing a darker textured end. The metal appears dark brown with flecks of lighter bronze or gold tones, indicating a worn, aged look. The side view on the left displays a round, knob-like handle projecting from the surface of the door, fixed to a small rectangular plate. The background is a uniform light beige or cream color, and the objects are centrally placed with no other elements present. In small script at the bottom right of the drawing, there is a signature or artist’s name: "L. VERCHERE."
title: Wrought Iron Latch
